facts.text: Product identity: Wave Kinect Propel Arctic Ice Mattress.
Selected variant: Queen, 78 x 60 in (198 x 152 cm), 8 in (20.3 cm) high.
The product specifications list Pocket Spring as the mattress material.
The listed mattress feel is Medium Soft.
The listed top style is Tight Top and the listed colour is Cream.
Listed features include a 3 Zone Copper NRG Layer, 3-Zone Pocketed spring, Anti Stress Fabric, and compatibility with Wave Range of Smart Beds.
The product comes with a 10-year conditional warranty.
